derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός);
def: to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally

occurrences.text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
